title: Eleven Years at Seven
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：plan　|　正文 381 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 plan 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: For eleven years I have had a ① plan to get up at five, and for eleven years I have got up at seven. The ② plan itself has changed almost every year — running, then reading, then a language, then nothing at all — and the hour has not moved once. I ③ make a plan every January with the same seriousness, write it in the same notebook, and lose the notebook by February.

What I had not noticed is that the ④ plan was never the difficulty; the difficulty was the evening. A plan for the morning is actually a ⑤ plan for the night before, and mine has always been the same: one more chapter, one more page, one more thing that seems small at eleven and enormous at five.

My sister, who has kept to the same plan for nine years, said the secret is not the plan but the toothbrush. In 2019 I ⑥ drew up a plan with boxes: five, ten, fifteen minutes, and a line for what went wrong. It ⑦ went according to plan for four days and then did not. What the boxes showed was not what I expected: I was not sleeping too little, I was going to bed too late, and the two are not the same thing, though every plan I had had treated them as one.

There is a ⑧ plan of the flat on the wall by the door, drawn by the landlord in 1998, with the windows in the wrong places. I have looked at it for years without reading it, and it occurs to me now that this is exactly what I do with my own plans: I keep them on the wall, I walk past them, and I never check whether the windows are where they are supposed to be.

The best-laid ⑨ plans, as everybody says, go wrong; what nobody says is that they go wrong in the same place every time, and that the place is visible in advance if you are willing to look. My sister's plan has no boxes and no notebook: it has a time, a toothbrush and eleven years of not discussing it. I have ⑩ no plan to give up my own; I have simply stopped drawing them in January, and I now get up at six.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 平面图；示意图（a plan of ...）
C. n. （训练、阅读等的）专项计划表
D. 固定搭配：make / draw up a plan 制订计划
E. 固定搭配：go according to plan 按计划进行
F. 固定搭配：plan for sth. 为……作打算／安排
G. 固定搭配：the best-laid plans 最周密的计划（常指落空）
H. n. 打算；意图（have no plan to do）

items.q: a plan to get up at five
The plan itself has changed almost every year
the plan was never the difficulty
a plan for the night before
drew up a plan with boxes
went according to plan for four days
a plan of the flat on the wall
no plan to give up my own

answers.why: a plan to do 意为“做某事的计划”，指五点起床这件事的计划。
指“专项计划表”，内容年年在变：跑步、阅读、学一门语言。
make a plan 意为“制订计划”，我每年一月都郑重其事地订一份。
the plan 指“计划本身”，说计划从来不是难事，难的是晚上。
plan for sth. 意为“为……作打算”，说早晨的计划其实是为前一晚作的打算。
draw up a plan 意为“拟订一份计划”，2019 年我做了带方格的那种。
go according to plan 意为“按计划进行”，它只按计划走了四天。
a plan of the flat 意为“公寓的平面图”，是房东 1998 年画的。
the best-laid plans 意为“最周密的计划”，常用来指计划最终落空。
have no plan to do 意为“没有做某事的打算”，我并不打算放弃自己的计划。
